events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, lead singer of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, in Manchester, England.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that iconic swagger and unforgettable voice to the world. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo studio album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, following its US release on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 55 Years On
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album's message of peace and unity resonates just as powerfully today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket was revolutionary? It was 25 years ago this month that Apple introduced the first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which 007 film or song is your all-time favourite? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Marwood Cleese, the iconic British actor, comedian, and screenwriter, was born on October 27, 1939, in Weston-super-Mare, England.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental 'White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and still sounds incredible today.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to rock the world. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was first released in the United Kingdom on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released the groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that marked a significant evolution in their sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a visionary. We remember John Lennon, whose enduring message of peace and incredible musical legacy continue to resonate.
